# Golf tee time pricing and utilization

`golfops` 0.3.0 summarizes unused capacity and revenue for Dobson Ranch
from the City of Mesa daily operating extract. Operating charts share
one daily sample. The package prepares the file, shows utilization of
the daylight estimate, summarizes revenue relationships, runs pricing
scenarios whose volume changes are typed in by the user, and compares a
seasonal baseline with one interpretable forecast of observed daily
rounds.

The extract has no tee time, posted rate, or booking timestamp.
Scenarios are accounting illustrations. They are not price elasticities
and not recommended tee-time prices. Forecasts predict observed rounds.
They do not estimate latent demand on days at or above the daylight
capacity.

## Why this dataset

Tee-sheet files from course operators were not available for this
version. Dobson Ranch is public, has a published data dictionary, and is
usable for participation and revenue once the grain of the file is
respected.

Catalog: [Dobson Ranch Golf
Rounds](https://data.mesaaz.gov/Parks-Recreation-and-Community-Facilities/Dobson-Ranch-Golf-Rounds/24g5-hb8k)
(`24g5-hb8k`). The catalog says the course is operated by Paradigm Golf
Group. On October 3, 2026 the SODA endpoint returned:

- 1,838 rows and 23 fields, matching the catalog and this extract
- dates from 2004-12-10 through 2026-04-30
- 868,646 rounds played, matching this extract
- a last update timestamp of October 2, 2026

The 2026-04-30 API total is \$55,134.93. The CSV total is \$55,135.
Component sums in the CSV stay within \$0.50 of the printed total, which
fits dollar rounding. The package keeps the CSV as the example file and
does not silently replace it with the API.

## What the validation changes

[`audit_golf_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/audit_golf_rounds.md)
is the check to read before any chart. The findings that control the
analysis:

- 1,766 rows are daily. 72 rows, July 2015 through June 2021, are
  monthly totals dated the 1st. The largest daily total is 675 rounds
  and the smallest monthly total is 2,963, so a cutoff of 1,000
  separates them in this file. Do not add the two grains together.
- The continuous daily series runs from 2021-07-01 through 2026-04-30
  and is missing 2024-12-10. 2004-12-10 is a separate one-day row and
  stays in the audit. Operating charts use
  [`dobson_operating_daily()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_operating_daily.md),
  which omits that isolated day. 2022-04-24 is duplicated exactly, and
  one copy is kept.
- The city’s `Revenue/Round` equals total revenue divided by rounds
  played. It is blank when rounds are zero. It is facility revenue per
  played round, not a green fee.
- `Round Booking Rate` equals rounds played divided by
  `Rounds Possible`. The catalog defines `Rounds Possible` from
  daylight, not from the tee sheet. Utilization can exceed 1.
- Cart revenue is blank on early rows. Where it is blank and the other
  five categories are present, those five already equal total revenue. A
  blank is not a hidden cart amount, and it should not be read as a
  measured zero unless the source says zero.
- Zero-round days still show facility revenue and cluster in October.
  Per-played-round yield is undefined on those days. The file does not
  give the reason play stopped.

2022, 2023, and 2025 are complete calendar years in the daily series.
2024 is missing one day. 2021 and 2026 are partial.

## What this version delivers from the proposal

| Proposal function | This package | Status |
|----|----|----|
| `prepare_golf_data()` | [`prepare_dobson_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/prepare_dobson_rounds.md) | Delivered for the Mesa CSV |
| `summarize_utilization()` | [`summarize_golf_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/summarize_golf_rounds.md), [`plot_utilization_heatmap()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_utilization_heatmap.md) | Delivered at day, week, weekday, month, season, and year. Capacity is labeled as the daylight estimate unless an operating calendar supplies a better basis |
| `plot_tee_patterns()` | [`plot_participation()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_participation.md), [`plot_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_revenue.md), [`plot_seasonal_overlay()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_seasonal_overlay.md), [`plot_utilization_heatmap()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_utilization_heatmap.md) | Delivered for weekday, week, month-of-year, and a daily utilization calendar. Not a tee-time heatmap |
| `simulate_pricing()` | [`simulate_price_volume()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/simulate_price_volume.md) | Delivered with user-supplied demand assumptions |
| `compare_course_rates()`, `compare_pass_value()` |  | Not in this version. No rate card or pass file is in the extract |
| `estimate_event_tradeoff()` | [`tournament_breakeven()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/tournament_breakeven.md) | A full-day or user-supplied partial-day baseline. Contribution is omitted until costs and margins are supplied. Not an estimated tradeoff and not a quote |

[`audit_golf_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/audit_golf_rounds.md)
and
[`metric_definitions()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/metric_definitions.md)
support the four delivered functions. They record grain, duplicates, and
what each revenue metric is not.

The forecast workflow is shared.
[`forecast_dobson_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_dobson_rounds.md)
fits observed rounds on weekday and month.
[`forecast_tournament_tickets()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_tournament_tickets.md)
fits a separate model for a fictional spectator-ticket series, on
weekday and days until the event. Both use
[`compare_demand_forecasts()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/compare_demand_forecasts.md),
a seasonal baseline, and a chronological holdout. The ticket series is
generated and labeled synthetic. It is not the course-tournament
break-even calculator. That calculator,
[`tournament_breakeven()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/tournament_breakeven.md),
compares supplied event revenue with observed regular-play green fees
and does not quote a price.

[`revenue_relationships()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/revenue_relationships.md)
reports category revenue per dollar of green fees as a ratio of sums.
[`course_period()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_period.md)
and
[`course_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_revenue.md)
are the small tables an importer should produce. foreUP, Lightspeed
Golf, and GolfNow are named in
[`future_operator_exports()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/future_operator_exports.md)
as possible authorized exports. No importer is claimed for them.

Period yields are ratios of sums. They are not averages of daily yields.
[`simulate_price_volume()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/simulate_price_volume.md)
rescales realized green-fee yield and rounds. Ancillary revenue, total
minus green fees, can be held constant or scaled with rounds. Neither
choice is an estimated demand response. The assumptions are part of the
returned object.

## Worked example

The vignette `dobson-ranch` loads the bundled extract, prints the audit,
and then uses the shared daily sample for seasonal overlays, a
utilization heatmap, revenue ratios, the 2025 scenarios, and an
illustrative tournament baseline. One scenario raises realized green-fee
yield 10 percent and lowers rounds 5 percent. That 5 percent is an
assumption, not a result.

``` r

library(golfops)
rounds <- prepare_dobson_rounds()
audit_golf_rounds(rounds)

daily <- rounds[rounds$grain == "day", ]
summarize_golf_rounds(daily, by = "weekday", duplicates = "drop_extra")
```

From this project directory, with the package dependencies installed.
RStudio supplies pandoc for the vignette. In a plain terminal, set
`RSTUDIO_PANDOC` to the directory that contains RStudio’s pandoc before
building vignettes.

``` r

devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()
vignette("dobson-ranch", package = "golfops")
```

The raw export lives in `sources/` and is read-only. The package reads
`inst/extdata/dobson_ranch_golf_rounds.csv`, a byte copy of that CSV.

## Outside this version

Country-club equity, cart GPS, and a live scoring app are outside this
version. A tee sheet would be required before a posted-price test.

City of Mesa. “Dobson Ranch Golf Rounds.” Mesa Open Data, dataset
24g5-hb8k. Accessed October 3, 2026.
<https://data.mesaaz.gov/Parks-Recreation-and-Community-Facilities/Dobson-Ranch-Golf-Rounds/24g5-hb8k>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`apply_operating_capacity()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/apply_operating_capacity.md)
  : Resolve capacity and operating status for prepared daily rows
- [`apply_volume_scenario()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/apply_volume_scenario.md)
  : Rescale a forecast by an assumed volume change
- [`audit_golf_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/audit_golf_rounds.md)
  : Audit a prepared Dobson Ranch table
- [`compare_demand_forecasts()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/compare_demand_forecasts.md)
  : Compare a seasonal baseline with one demand model
- [`course_capacity()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_capacity.md)
  : Daily tee times and player slots from an operating window
- [`course_events()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_events.md)
  : Optional event list documented independently of the rounds file
- [`course_period()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_period.md)
  : One row per course and period for participation
- [`course_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_revenue.md)
  : Revenue categories for the same course period
- [`course_weather()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/course_weather.md)
  : Optional weather observations or forecast-time weather
- [`daily_utilization()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/daily_utilization.md)
  : Daily tee-sheet use against a course capacity schedule
- [`dobson_column_names()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_column_names.md)
  : Column names in the City of Mesa Dobson Ranch export
- [`dobson_course_period()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_course_period.md)
  : Dobson operating rows in the course-period shape
- [`dobson_course_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_course_revenue.md)
  : Dobson revenue categories in the course-revenue shape
- [`dobson_operating_daily()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_operating_daily.md)
  : Daily Dobson Ranch rows used for operating charts and forecasts
- [`dobson_rounds`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_rounds.md)
  : Dobson Ranch golf rounds and realized revenue
- [`dobson_rounds_demand()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_rounds_demand.md)
  : Dobson Ranch daily rounds as a demand series
- [`dobson_rounds_example()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/dobson_rounds_example.md)
  : Path to the bundled Dobson Ranch example extract
- [`estimate_observed_activity()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/estimate_observed_activity.md)
  : Estimate Dobson rounds and green-fee revenue for specific dates
- [`evaluate_forecast()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/evaluate_forecast.md)
  : Score forecasts against observed outcomes
- [`forecast_demand_model()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_demand_model.md)
  : Forecast with one interpretable linear model
- [`forecast_dobson_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_dobson_rounds.md)
  : Compare Dobson Ranch round forecasts on a chronological holdout
- [`forecast_seasonal_baseline()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_seasonal_baseline.md)
  : Forecast with training means for the same calendar keys
- [`forecast_tournament_tickets()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/forecast_tournament_tickets.md)
  : Forecast the synthetic tournament with its own model
- [`future_operator_exports()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/future_operator_exports.md)
  : Names of operator exports that are not yet importers
- [`join_course_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/join_course_revenue.md)
  : Attach revenue to participation without adding a month to a day
- [`metric_definitions()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/metric_definitions.md)
  : Definitions for the participation and revenue metrics
- [`operating_calendar()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/operating_calendar.md)
  : Optional operating calendar for one course
- [`peoria_rate_card()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/peoria_rate_card.md)
  : Posted prices from the Peoria rate sheet
- [`peoria_rate_fences()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/peoria_rate_fences.md)
  : Rate fences on the Peoria posted card
- [`plot_annual_carts()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_annual_carts.md)
  : Cart rentals by year
- [`plot_annual_golfers()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_annual_golfers.md)
  : Golfers by year
- [`plot_annual_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_annual_revenue.md)
  : Annual revenue by type
- [`plot_annual_revenue_mix()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_annual_revenue_mix.md)
  : Annual revenue mix
- [`plot_calendar_day()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_calendar_day.md)
  : Capacity or utilization for each calendar day
- [`plot_capacity_demand()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_capacity_demand.md)
  : Capacity, demand, and utilization for each year
- [`plot_daylight_share()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_daylight_share.md)
  : Daily share of the daylight estimate
- [`plot_forecast()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_forecast.md)
  : Plot holdout actuals against both forecasts
- [`plot_participation()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_participation.md)
  : Plot rounds or utilization from a summary
- [`plot_revenue()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_revenue.md)
  : Plot realized revenue per round from a summary
- [`plot_revenue_by_golfers()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_revenue_by_golfers.md)
  : Daily revenue against golfers
- [`plot_revenue_mix()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_revenue_mix.md)
  : Dollars per golfer, stacked
- [`plot_revpatr()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_revpatr.md)
  : RevPATR by year
- [`plot_seasonal_overlay()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_seasonal_overlay.md)
  : Plot one seasonal series with a line for each year
- [`plot_utilization_heatmap()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/plot_utilization_heatmap.md)
  : Calendar heatmap of utilization against resolved capacity
- [`prepare_demand()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/prepare_demand.md)
  : Prepare a demand series for a shared forecast workflow
- [`prepare_dobson_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/prepare_dobson_rounds.md)
  : Prepare the City of Mesa Dobson Ranch rounds export
- [`revenue_per_available_round()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/revenue_per_available_round.md)
  : Revenue per available round by year
- [`revenue_per_golfer()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/revenue_per_golfer.md)
  : Revenue per golfer by year
- [`revenue_relationships()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/revenue_relationships.md)
  : Historical revenue per dollar of green-fee revenue
- [`review_dobson_anomalies()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/review_dobson_anomalies.md)
  : Review the largest Dobson participation and range-revenue days
- [`sample_tee_sheet`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/sample_tee_sheet.md)
  : Synthetic municipal tee sheet
- [`seasonal_overlay_data()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/seasonal_overlay_data.md)
  : January–December values by year for the operating sample
- [`simulate_price_volume()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/simulate_price_volume.md)
  : Apply a user-specified price and volume scenario
- [`split_chronological()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/split_chronological.md)
  : Split a demand series on a date, without shuffling
- [`summarize_golf_rounds()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/summarize_golf_rounds.md)
  : Summarize participation and revenue for one grain
- [`synthetic_tournament_tickets()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/synthetic_tournament_tickets.md)
  : Synthetic ticket sales for a hypothetical golf tournament
- [`tournament_breakeven()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/tournament_breakeven.md)
  : Break-even baseline for hosting a course tournament
- [`utilization_calendar()`](https://jlocke1979.github.io/golf-revenue-management/reference/utilization_calendar.md)
  : Calendar of daily utilization, including dates the extract skipped
